comments.body: Fixed in commit 1c4a0d4: sized the `out` buffer in `src/server.rs` to 40 bytes (`tless_uor::TlessAxisImpl::MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES`) so `predict()` receives a sufficiently sized buffer and `census(31)` (`out[33..37]`) reads valid memory without panicking.

Fixed in commit d3400d4: corrected all field offsets in `PartitionProductFields for TlessPredictOutput` (`src/tless_uor.rs`) to match the exact byte boundaries serialized in `predict()` (e.g. `candidate_scans` is now `(33, 4)`).

## Pull request overview This PR implements Issue #14 by extending the transformerless runtime’s `OpKernel` census with a per-candidate “scan” counter, then threads that new counter through the TLESS axis serialization, server JSON output, and allocation census tests. **Changes:** - Add `candidate_scans` to `OpKernel` and increment it in runtime loops that iterate over candidate classes/tokens. - Extend TLESS predict output serialization and field partition metadata to include `candidate_scans` (output size increases to 37 bytes). - Update server JSON output and allocation census test code to surface/track the new counter and updated token types/signatures. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `crates/uor-r4-core/src/transformerless/runtime.rs` | Adds the `candidate_scans` counter and instruments candidate-iteration points to increment it. | | `src/tless_uor.rs` | Extends axis output record/shape to serialize `candidate_scans` and bumps output sizing constants. | | `src/server.rs` | Adds `candidate_scans` to the JSON census payload. | | `crates/uor-r4-core/tests/allocation_census.rs` | Updates op-census snapshot/test plumbing for the new counter and updated evidence/token types. |

review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Size the server census buffer for the new counter**

The server still creates `out` as `[0u8; 36]` a few lines above, but this patch makes `TlessAxisImpl::predict` require `TLESS_OUTPUT_BYTES == 37` and serialize `candidate_scans` into bytes `33..37`. On any successful `/api/tless/predict` path, the ignored predict call now returns `Err` for the short buffer, and this added `census(31)` then slices `out[33..37]` past the 36-byte array, so the handler panics instead of returning the JSON response. Please size this buffer from `TLESS_OUTPUT_BYTES` (or at least 37) before reading the new counter.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

                             "table_reads": census(27),
+                            "candidate_scans": census(31),
                             "multiply": 0,
review_comments.body: Adding `candidate_scans` to the JSON census makes the server rely on bytes 33..37 from the axis output, but the axis output buffer earlier in this handler is still `[0u8; 36]` and the `predict` result is ignored. With `TLESS_OUTPUT_BYTES = 37`, this can lead to a panic when computing `census(31)`. Update the earlier buffer to at least `tless_uor::TLESS_OUTPUT_BYTES` (or `TlessAxisImpl::MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES`) and handle `TlessAxisImpl::predict` errors before parsing.

`PartitionProductFields::FIELDS` offsets don’t match the actual byte layout written in `predict` (e.g., `candidate_scans` is serialized at bytes 33..37, but the field table entry starts at 31). Other shapes in the repo (e.g. `crates/uor-r4-router/src/lib.rs` `R4RoutingOutput`) use byte offsets, so this table likely causes consumers that rely on field partitioning to read incorrect data.
